comparison.objective: Shave a manikin's cheek and jaw while holding the cheek skin taut and avoiding sensitive features.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual skin tensioning plus force-limited curved-surface following with an electric shaver.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% coverage and shaver returned, released, and still; excessive force, sensitive-feature contact, head displacement, or dropping latches zero.
comparison.reason: Force-controlled surface coverage on compliant anatomy is unrelated to coaxial adjustment, jam-nut counterholding, and retained articulated motion.
